text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelous☆ Ikuno celebrated with me too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays seem truly special for 
Marvelous-san as well. Her voice almost 
sounds an octave higher than usual.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You pay attention to me even in things 
like that? Ikuno, you really are an eager 
student! Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That last one was a Marvelous meant for 
Nature-san as well, used when praising an 
opponent.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is the Marvelous for when one 
encounters surprise and deep emotion.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard that before...! What kind 
of meaning was packed into that Marvelous 
just now?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A new Marvelous☆ born from Ikuno and me 
growing closer!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Birthdays bring out so many marvelous 
things, they truly are marvelous days, 
aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'll still need some time to 
truly understand, but... I'm honestly 
happy that we've managed to close the 
distance between us.
